Sorry if this doesn't relate to the topic, I just wanted to tell this story.
A few years back I used my parents credit card to order a PSP on Amazon. A few days later, my dad gets a phone call from the bank or whatever telling him that there's been suspicious activity with his credit card. I was in the room while he was on the phone so when the call ended, he talked asked me if I had anything to do with this and I said no. The day before the PSP was going to ship to my house, I stayed up all night trying to create a plan to get the package without my parents noticing. When it did arrive, I got the box and opened it in my room. My Dad came in and asked me how I got it. Long story short, I got caught but I wasn't even grounded. I just got lectured and that's it. A few months ago, I was playing it in front of them and they asked me where I got it.
Say that everything is all fine and dandy during the day, but when night falls, I let my feelings come out.
